item.title: Kacey Musgraves Finds Herself In The ‘Middle of Nowhere’: Stream It Now
item.description:
[Intro music plays]
Host: Welcome to our podcast, where we dive into the latest music news. Today, we're excited to talk about Kacey Musgraves' brand new album, "Middle of Nowhere".
[Soft music transitions in the background]
Host: Kacey Musgraves is back with a baker's dozen collection of tracks that explore the emotions of post-breakup solitude and finding oneself in a solitary life stage. As she recently shared with Texas Monthly, this album period coincided with her getting more comfortable being alone, not as isolation, but as sovereignty.
[Music transitions to a short clip of Western music]
Host: This album is special, as it nods to traditional Western music styles and weaves in Mexican music elements, paying homage to its long-reaching influence on country music. You'll hear washes of accordion, acoustic guitar, and pedal steel, along with Texas dancehall percussion.
[Music transitions to a short clip of country music]
Host: Kacey teams up with some amazing artists on this album, including Willie Nelson, Miranda Lambert, Billy Strings, and Gregory Alan Isakov. This is the successor to her 2024 album "Deeper Well", which debuted at number one on Billboard's Top Country Albums chart.
[Music transitions to a short clip of Kacey Musgraves' music]
Host: To celebrate the release of "Middle of Nowhere", Kacey is gearing up for her tour later this year, kicking off in Chicago on August 21st and wrapping up in Seattle on October 27th. She'll also be performing at the 61st annual Academy of Country Music Awards on May 17th.
[Outro music plays]
Host: That's all for today. You can stream Kacey Musgraves' new album "Middle of Nowhere" now. Thanks for tuning in, and we'll catch you on the next episode.
[Outro music continues to play until the end]
